metadata.result:
Phase 2 is complete. Summary of what was implemented:

**`src/server/recordings.ts`** — 6 route handlers dispatched by a single `handleRecordings()` function:
- `POST /api/recordings` — creates recording, writes `meta.json` + empty `frames.ndjson`, arms 6h watchdog
- `POST /api/recordings/:id/frames` — appends frame line via `node:fs/promises appendFile`, increments in-memory counter
- `POST /api/recordings/:id/stop` — counts lines, sets `complete=true`, cancels watchdog
- `GET /api/recordings` — lists dirs, reads each `meta.json`, sorts by `startTime` desc
- `GET /api/recordings/:id/frames` — streams `frames.ndjson` as `application/x-ndjson`
- `DELETE /api/recordings/:id` — `rm -rf` the directory

Key design notes: `getRecordingsDir()` reads `process.env.WORLDVIEW_RECORDINGS_DIR` on every call (not at module load) so tests can override it. `_testOnlyFireFinalize()` is exported to trigger the watchdog logic synchronously in tests.

**`src/server/index.ts`** — `["/api/recordings", handleRecordings]` added to the dynamic prefix table.

**`.gitignore`** — `recordings/` added.

**`src/__tests__/server-recordings.test.ts`** — 9 tests, all passing: covers create, append+stop, list, fetch-frames, delete, 404-on-unknown, watchdog.

**`scripts/verify-phase2.sh`** — boots a minimal server on port 3099, exercises all 6 endpoints with curl, exits 0 with `OK`.
